articles.text: WÁNG XIĀNSHENG: Jīntian wǒmen yìqǐ qù chī zhōngfàn, hǎo ma?
MR. WÁNG: Let's go have lunch together today. Okay?
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Hǎo a, dào Dōngmén Cāntīng qu chī ba.
MR. ANDERSON: All right. Why don't we go to the East Gate Restaurant?
WÁNG XIĀNSHENG: Dōngménde cài méiyou Dàhuáde cài nàme hǎo.
MR. WÁNG: The food at the East Gate isn't as good as at the Great China.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Suīrán bú tài hǎo, kěshi lí wǒmen zhèli jìn.
MR. ANDERSON: Even though it's not too good, it's close to us.
WÁNG XIĀNSHENG: Hái yǒu yíge xīn kāide fànguǎnzi lí wǒmen gèng jìn.
MR. WÁNG: There's also a newly opened restaurant that's even closer to us.
WÁNG XIĀNSHENG: Jīntian wǒ qǐng ni dào nàli qù chī.
MR. WÁNG: Today I'm inviting you to eat there.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Nà bù hǎo yìsi!
MR. ANDERSON: I can't let you do that!
WÁNG XIĀNSHENG: Bié kèqi. Nèige dìfangde cài yòu hǎo yòu piányi.
MR. WÁNG: Don't be polite. The food there is both good and cheap.
